# Big Bear Truck Repair

> 24-hour commercial truck repair in Wyoming, MI (Grand Rapids metro area).

## Business Summary

Big Bear Truck Repair is a commercial truck repair shop based in Wyoming, Michigan, serving the greater Grand Rapids and West Michigan area. The business provides 24-hour service Monday through Saturday (closed Sunday). They work on commercial trucks of all sizes, from box trucks and delivery vans to full-size semis.

## Contact

- Phone: (616) 329-0848
- Email: bigbeartruckrepair@gmail.com
- Service Area: Wyoming, Grand Rapids, and West Michigan

## Hours

- Monday through Saturday: 24 hours
- Sunday: Closed

## Services

- General Truck Repairs: engine, transmission, brakes, electrical, suspension, cooling systems
- Truck Diagnostics: electronic fault code analysis, engine performance testing, pre-purchase inspections
- Fleet Maintenance: scheduled preventive maintenance, multi-point inspections, oil changes
- Roadside Assistance & Emergency Repair: 24-hour emergency dispatch, on-site breakdown repair

## Key Differentiators

- 24-hour availability Monday through Saturday (most competitors operate business hours only)
- Honest diagnostics: they fix what needs fixing and tell you if a requested repair is unnecessary
- Commercial truck specialists serving the Grand Rapids metro area
